title: Texture: Something That Moves
brief: Make a sound that changes on its own while it plays — not a flat, static tone. Three modules, no sequencer, and no keyboard: this one runs by itself. Try Noise → VCF → Output, then patch the LFO's "Out" into the VCF's "CV" jack and turn the filter's Amt knob up — the cutoff will slowly sweep instead of sitting still. (An oscillator's pitch works just as well as a filter's cutoff, if you'd rather try that instead.) Let it run for a few seconds without touching anything.
